decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family in a design-driven hardware line typically stays in the catalogue for many years to recover tooling and design investment.
A mitred handle family launched only in 2023 fits the firm's architectural portfolio and is unlikely to be withdrawn after one year.
A multifunctional lever adds value to the range and needs more than a year to win specifications in building projects.
A single new lever model has low ongoing cost once tooled, so the firm would keep it in the catalogue.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection is prominently promoted and central to the brand's design reputation.
A new bronze finish extends existing product lines at little added cost and suits current architectural trends.
